name: REMAP
description: A controlled benchmark for evaluating multiview spatial reasoning in vision-language models, requiring alignment of allocentric maps with multiple egocentric observations to test cross-view geometric correspondence.
reputation: A recent controlled benchmark that is useful for probing multiview spatial reasoning, but it is still early-stage and not yet broadly established as a standard evaluation.
notes: Synthetic triangle environments with varied angle configurations; evaluates geometric dual representations and cross-view spatial reasoning in VLMs.
